definition: Plays counted in a Poki player fit test: 500 players tried the game; this test measures playtime only, so conversion to play is not recorded
Total playtime in the player fit test, derived by hand from Poki's average playtime of 4.5 minutes x 500 plays / 60; Poki reports the average, not the total
Plays from category pages during a Poki web fit test of about 7 days; Poki compares click-through rate and conversion to play with category averages and shows both as percentages
